text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview, and recommend candidates to the Toronto and East York Community Council for appointment to the McCormick Playground Arena Board. This report recommends the appointment of one public member to the McCormick Playground Arena Board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed Philip Roe to the McCormick Playground Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending July 10, 2029 and until a successor is appointed. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 2, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals.
